name: gen5-chomp-tour
derived_from: solver/rotom/arms/gen5-chomp-top.json (arm A unchanged, byte for byte); only the rotation differs
question: gen5-chomp played on the TOURNAMENT rotation (Will, 2026-10-01: real top-cut teams from Reg M-C open-team-list events, with their sources). Same readiness and smoke questions as gen5-chomp-top: every preview by CHOMP and applied by the server (0 preview mismatches, 0 chomp failures, 0 self quits), and the rated record without opponent quits. A readiness run, NOT a strength test: one arm, no SPRT. Its residuals are NOT pooled with gen5-chomp or gen5-chomp-top: the rotation is part of the arm, and team choice is a far larger effect than the policy.
offline_evidence: CHOMP v1: gate (b) SPRT H1 vs the human-modal bring, 0.561 [0.518, 0.603], 524 games; gate (c) vs the humans' own recorded bring 0.470 [0.422, 0.519], 400 games (report-only; no clear edge over human bring choice). solver/results/2026-09-27-chomp-v1/, release eaa5becc54eb, data/team-pool-frozen-regmc, honest information, gen5 1 s both sides.
rotation_rule: solver/rotom/build_tour_rotation.js: the legal Masters teams of the tournament store (data/tournaments/regmc/, solver/tournaments/); team weight = tier x log10(max(players,10))/3 x 1/sqrt(placing); leader clustering at >= 4 shared species; clusters in descending summed weight, each played as its leader (its best-weighted team) with the real published sheet, skipping a cluster that would put a mega forme on more than 2 picked teams, up to 5 teams; Stat Points from the tournament store where a paste published them for the same species + item + nature (Victory Road Replica Teams), else derived by solver/rotom/spreads.js; fallback bring = the human-modal option. The rule, every cluster considered and each team's event, placing and paste URL are recorded in the rotation file and in every series row's team_meta.source.

A.note: Exactly gen5-vs-prior.json arm A (gen5 MAG/DODUO/PORYGON2, k 4x4, depth 0, 1 reserved switch row; search capped at 5 s and bound below it by the clock; XATU back-pair posterior + spread prior), except the preview: CHOMP v1 (solver/chomp/v1/chomp1.js, with the bo3 adjustment from the series' previous game) instead of the rotation team's own human bring. On a CHOMP throw or illegal answer the preview falls to the team's bring, counted chomp:threw / chomp:illegal. The fixed 5 s clock, not the adaptive one, so the arm differs from gen5ab arm A in the preview alone.

assignment: every series is arm A (one arm; sha256(seed|k|arm) mod 1); the team is drawn per series from the arm's rotation (solver/rotom/teams/ladder-rotation-tour.json) by solver/rotom/ladder.js assign, committed before the first game
metric: per-series residual r = S - E, E = 1/(1+10^((R_opp - R_me)/400)) from the server's pre-series ratings; ties S = 0.5. Read over rated series only, with and without the series won by an opponent quit (solver/rotom/report.js ladder)

readiness_bars.preview: every preview decision answered by CHOMP (summary preview_by.chomp == preview decisions); chomp:threw and chomp:illegal both 0; preview_mismatch 0 on every row
readiness_bars.safety: self_quits 0; timeouts 0; invalid 0; applied_mismatch 0; 0 ladder errors
readiness_bars.search: gen5 move decisions searched; prior fallbacks counted and stated

burn_in: series played while the account's pre-series rating is below 1300 are burn-in (all of this run is expected to be)
headline: none from this run. The headline is the mean rating over the last N >= 100 series +- SD. Never the peak.
